about: 31, lives in Queens, a teacher. Cares only about how good the food is for the money. Happy standing at a counter or eating on the street. Dislikes fancy, pricey, reservation-only places.

places.name: Xi'an Famous Foods
places.note: Spicy hand-pulled noodles for under $15. Fast, no frills, insanely good.

places.name: Joe's Pizza
places.note: The perfect classic New York slice. Eat it standing on the sidewalk.

places.name: Los Tacos No. 1
places.note: Standing-room tacos, short menu, everything made fresh in front of you. Worth the line.

places.name: Mamoun's Falafel
places.note: Cheap, open late, been around forever. Best falafel sandwich after a night out.

places.name: McSorley's Old Ale House
places.note: Ancient bar, only two beers (light or dark), sawdust on the floor, cheap and no pretense.

dislikes.name: Carbone
dislikes.note: Impossible to book and $30+ for a bowl of pasta. Feels like you're paying for the show.

dislikes.name: Le Bain
dislikes.note: Cover charge, dress code, $20 cocktails. Too much effort to have a drink.
